headline: Rising UK Interest Rates Drive Up Mortgage and Consumer Borrowing Costs
summary: Anticipated UK interest rate increases are expected to raise borrowing costs across mortgages, credit cards, and consumer loans.
why: The Bank of England's interest rate policy influences benchmark commercial lending rates, consumer spending power, and real estate valuations across the United Kingdom.

impacts.name: UK Policy Interest Rate
impacts.why: Higher official interest rates directly increase interest payments on mortgages and credit facilities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
